ref.desc: Button groups combine related buttons into a single visual unit.

conv.desc: Related actions in one unit. Native div.btn-group or optional light-DOM <harmony-button-group>. Selected = primary (or .btn--selected); others outline.

ref.desc: List menus display a vertical list of interactive items for navigation or selection.

conv.desc: Vertical list for navigation or selection. Native nav.list-menu with a/button.list-menu__item, or optional light-DOM <harmony-list-menu> that adds item classes.

forcedColors.border: 0px 0px 1px none none solid rgb(0, 0, 159) rgb(0, 0, 159) rgb(0, 0, 0)

ref.desc: Notification badges are small indicators used to display notification counts as dots, numbers, or overflow text (e.g., "99+").

conv.desc: Small indicators via <harmony-notification-badge>. Standalone (empty host) or wrap a target in the default slot; the badge sits at position (default top-end).
